children: Dublin-based building materials distributor's H1 revenue rose 6.7%, led by growth in Iberia and Ireland
Adjusted EPS grew 10.8%, reflecting capital allocation and share buybacks
Company maintained full-year profit guidance and launched new £25 mln share buyback
Grafton maintains full-year adjusted operating profit guidance of £190m-£200m
Company expects H2 trading conditions to remain broadly consistent with H1
Grafton sees continued strength in Iberia and Ireland, with challenging conditions in Great Britain
IRELAND & IBERIA GROWTH - Strong trading and acquisitions in Iberia and Ireland drove profit growth, offsetting weaker performance elsewhere
ACQUISITIONS CONTRIBUTED - Integration and early trading of Mercaluz and Cygnum supported results, with performance in line with expectations
COST CONTROL & MARGIN MANAGEMENT - Disciplined cost control and margin management helped mitigate inflationary pressures
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 10 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the construction supplies & fixtures peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Grafton Group PLC is GBp1,150.00, about 13.7% above its September 2 closing price of GBp1,011.20
The stock recently traded at 13 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 11 three months ago
